subtopic: Euler Form, De Moivre's Theorem & Roots of a Complex Number
title: Euler's formula packages the polar form

board_content.text: One symbol for cos + i sin
A unit number $e^{i\theta}$ is just 'the arrow of length 1 pointing at angle $\theta$'.
This is a JEE extension — beyond strict NCERT Class-11 scope.

segments_english.text: <curious>What if that whole polar bracket could be written as a single exponential?</curious> That's exactly what Euler's formula does.
Euler's formula says e to the i theta equals cosine theta plus i sine theta. So any number becomes z equals r times e to the i theta.
Read a unit number, e to the i theta, as simply the arrow of length one pointing at angle theta. The whole polar form collapses into one clean symbol.
And here the geometry becomes literal algebra: e to the i theta one, times e to the i theta two, equals e to the i, theta one plus theta two, by the ordinary exponent rule.
So the slogan from before, multiplication is rotation, upgrades to something even simpler: multiplication just adds exponents.
Two consequences fall out immediately. The conjugate of r e to the i theta is r e to the minus i theta, and its reciprocal is one over r, times e to the minus i theta.
And running Euler backwards gives the inverse relations: cosine theta is e to the i theta plus e to the minus i theta, over two, and sine theta is the difference, over two i.
A quick note on scope: this subtopic is a JEE extension, beyond strict NCERT Class eleven. If you're preparing for boards only, you can treat it lightly.

segments_hinglish.text: <curious>Kya ho agar wo poora polar bracket ek single exponential ki tarah likha ja sake?</curious> Yehi Euler's formula karta hai.
Euler's formula kehta hai e to the i theta barabar cosine theta plus i sine theta. To koi bhi number ban jaata hai z equals r times e to the i theta.
Ek unit number, e to the i theta, ko bas length one wala arrow samjho jo angle theta par point karta hai. Poora polar form ek clean symbol mein collapse ho jaata hai.
Aur yahan geometry literal algebra ban jaati hai: e to the i theta one, times e to the i theta two, barabar e to the i, theta one plus theta two, ordinary exponent rule se.
To pehle wala slogan, multiplication is rotation, aur bhi simple cheez mein upgrade ho jaata hai: multiplication bas exponents add karta hai.
Do consequences turant nikalte hain. r e to the i theta ka conjugate hai r e to the minus i theta, aur iska reciprocal hai one over r, times e to the minus i theta.
Aur Euler ko ulta chalane se inverse relations milte hain: cosine theta hai e to the i theta plus e to the minus i theta, over two, aur sine theta hai difference, over two i.
Scope par ek quick note: ye subtopic JEE extension hai, strict NCERT Class eleven se aage. Agar sirf boards ke liye taiyaari hai, to ise halka le sakte ho.
